description: This source file is an implementation class for initializing and populating database references in a SalesManager system, including currencies, countries, zones, languages, merchant store, modules, and product types.

classes.name: InitializationDatabaseImpl
classes.description: Implementation of initialization routines for setting up default references and configurations in the system database.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Main method to initialize system data like languages, countries, zones, currencies, modules, and merchant store.

methods.name: isEmpty
methods.description: Check if the database is empty by verifying the count of languages.

methods.name: createLanguages
methods.description: Populate language references based on configured ISO codes.

methods.name: createCountries
methods.description: Add supported countries and their descriptions in various languages.

methods.name: createZones
methods.description: Load and create geographic zones from a JSON configuration.

methods.name: createCurrencies
methods.description: Create currency entries based on predefined codes.

methods.name: createMerchant
methods.description: Create a default merchant store with country, currency, language, zone, and other details.

methods.name: createModules
methods.description: Load and create integration modules from a JSON configuration.

methods.name: createSubReferences
methods.description: Create additional reference data like product types.
